meta.rowFormula: row = ctrl0*140 + (ctrl1*5 + ((ctrl2&0x7F)>>1))*7 + channel; byte = table[row*16 + step]
meta.stepByte: 0x00 = rest(key off); bit7 set = tie/hold; else absolute note number (same scale as composed pitchColumn+54), sent as note-on vel 127 on driver channel 5
meta.transpose: signed TRANSPOSE_TABLE[ctrl3] (kernel +0x1B3C8: -3,-2,-1,0,+1,+2,+3,+4,+5,+6,-5,-4) added ONLY to channels 0-3
meta.instrument: all 7 channels play tone-bank instrument 60+ctrl0 (one cmd4 per step on driver channel 5)
meta.tableEnd: 0x20350 (exactly 1260 rows x 16 bytes; pointer tables follow)
